_comment: The package identity Partner Center assigned, which is NOT a thing to invent.
Where to find it: Partner Center -> Apps and games -> Astrid -> Product management ->
Product identity. It shows three values; the two below are the ones the manifest needs.
'identityPublisher' is a machine-generated string that looks like CN= followed by a GUID.
It is NOT 'CN=Graceful Tools LLC'. The company name people read is PublisherDisplayName in
AppxManifest.xml, which is set separately and must match the account's publisher display
A package whose Identity differs from the reservation by a single character is rejected at
upload, which is why these are pasted rather than guessed. Until they are real,
scripts/package.ps1 substitutes an obviously-fake local identity so the package can still be
built and run through the Windows App Certification Kit — and says so, loudly, every run.
